message: Block implant bookings on Friday afternoon

session.text: Add an agenda service that validates a slot before booking. Implants cannot be booked on Friday afternoon (from 12:00). Dr. Mendes needs 48 hours of follow-up after an implant and he does not work on weekends.

expected.statement: Implants cannot be booked on Friday afternoon
